title: What is the visual plausibility trap?
summary: A world can look real while behaving incorrectly.
body: A generated environment may look convincing while its geometry, dynamics or physical constraints are wrong. World-model evaluation must therefore test functional reliability and valid behaviour rather than relying on photorealistic demonstrations.
